issue.message:
Library lint checks reference invalid APIs; these checks **will be skipped**!
Lint found an issue registry (`androidx.lifecycle.lint.LiveDataCoreIssueRegistry`) which contains some references to invalid API: org.jetbrains.kotlin.analysis.api.session.KtAnalysisSessionProvider: org.jetbrains.kotlin.analysis.api.lifetime.KtLifetimeTokenFactory getTokenFactory() (Referenced from androidx/lifecycle/lint/NonNullableMutableLiveDataDetector$createUastHandler$1.class)
Therefore, this lint check library is **not** included in analysis. This affects the following lint checks: `NullSafeMutableLiveData`
To use this lint check, upgrade to a more recent version of the library.
Class referenced in the manifest, `com.transistorsoft.tsbackgroundfetch.BackgroundFetchService`, was not found in the project or the libraries
Class referenced in the manifest, `com.transistorsoft.tsbackgroundfetch.BootReceiver`, was not found in the project or the libraries
WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is deprecated (and is not granted) when targeting Android 13+. If you need to write to shared storage, use the `MediaStore.createWriteRequest` intent.

READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is deprecated (and is not granted) when targeting Android 13+. If you need to query or interact with MediaStore or media files on the shared storage, you should instead use one or more new storage permissions: `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES`, `READ_MEDIA_VIDEO` or `READ_MEDIA_AUDIO`.
This class should provide a default constructor (a public constructor with no arguments) (`com.transistorsoft.rnbackgroundfetch.HeadlessTask`)
A newer version of com.google.mlkit:text-recognition than 16.0.0 is available: 16.0.1

The attribute `android:allowBackup` is deprecated from Android 12 and higher and may be removed in future versions. Consider adding the attribute `android:dataExtractionRules` specifying an `@xml` resource which configures cloud backups and device transfers on Android 12 and higher.
The resource `R.integer.react_native_dev_server_port` appears to be unused
The resource `R.mipmap.ic_notification` appears to be unused
The resource `R.drawable.ic_notification` appears to be unused
Should explicitly set `android:icon`, there is no default
